text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000183 bills 99215 at roughly three times the risk-adjusted expectation in every complexity band, but the documentation sample is too thin to separate upcoding from a complex panel.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"The elevated 99215 share appears in every complexity band, including patients with zero or one chronic condition. Sampled low-complexity 99215 claims carry simple diagnoses such as UTI (C0103924), upper respiratory infection (C0103950) and back pain (C0104665), which is the pattern most consistent with upcoding. Against that, sampled high-complexity 99215s (C0104442, C0104748) are on genuinely multimorbid patients and were documented as high MDM, as was low-complexity claim C0104546. Only one documented 99215 (C0104871, moderate MDM) fell below the billed level. With just 5 documented 99215 claims, the unsupported rate cannot be trusted, and the few data-reviewed notes lacking a lab or test line are only weak evidence of inflated notes. A reviewer should first request charts specifically for the low-complexity 99215 claims listed and check whether the MDM and time actually support level 5 for single acute or simple diagnoses."}
